listenings.text: Good afternoon. This is a message from your travel agency about your trip to Paris. Please listen and write the times. Your flight leaves on October first, at ten fifteen at night. You arrive in Paris on October second, at a quarter past one in the afternoon. The airport is very big and it is very busy in the afternoon, so please arrive three hours early. Your car to the hotel is at door number four, at three o'clock. Check-in at the hotel opens at two in the afternoon, so you have time. If you have a question, our office is open every day, from eight in the morning to six at night. Have a very good trip.

Hello, and thank you for calling Disneyland Paris. Here are our times for October. The park opens at half past nine in the morning and it closes at eleven o'clock at night. On Monday and on Tuesday, the park closes at nine. The big parade is at five o'clock in the afternoon, on the main street. Our restaurants are open all day, but they are very busy from twelve to two, so please eat before twelve or after two. The train from the center of Paris takes about forty minutes. Thank you, and see you in October.

extra_audio.text: The flight leaves on October first, at ten fifteen at night. They arrive on October second, at a quarter past one. At three o'clock in the afternoon, they are at the hotel. On October fifth, the family goes to Disneyland Paris. The parade starts at five in the afternoon.
